RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

An all-female panel is not evidence of bias; committee composition typically reflects routine departmental service assignments or administrative availability. 

Academic hiring decisions rarely hinge solely on paper counts or years taught. Committees evaluate departmental fit, interview performance, teaching demonstrations, and specific institutional needs—such as the selected candidate’s industry background.

Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of discrimination is unsubstantiated and carries substantial professional risk, potentially damaging your academic reputation and network. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your request for feedback, framing it constructively around how you can strengthen future applications and better align with departmental priorities.
